quote.text: Have nothing in your houses that you do not know to be useful, or believe to be beautiful.
quote.author: William Morris, “The Beauty of Life,” 1880

stories.headline: Twenty seconds a year, now in a watch you’d actually wear daily
stories.dek: Grand Seiko has moved its ±20-seconds-a-year Spring Drive “Ultra Fine Accuracy” movement out of precious metal and into everyday steel — the accuracy earns the ticket; the price ladder is the argument.

stories.kicker: Down the Rabbit Hole · The Invitation
stories.headline: Whisky, all the way down
stories.dek: Not the cocktail cabinet — the other obsession, where the bottle is the hero: a glass, a few drops of water, and the slow decoding of what a barrel and a decade did. Here is how the rabbit hole opens, and how far it goes.

stories.kicker: Iran & the Gulf · The second gate closes
stories.headline: The Houthis take Perim, and the war owns both doors to the oil
stories.dek: The seizure of a small island in the middle of Bab el-Mandeb this week completed a takeover of Yemen’s Red Sea coast — handing Iran’s allies a grip on a second chokepoint while Hormuz stays a shooting war, and driving Brent to a hundred and ten dollars.

stories.kicker: The haze · What it means for your weekend
stories.headline: The air turns “unhealthy” for the first time since 2023 — and may not clear for weeks
stories.dek: Transboundary smoke pushed the central region’s PSI past a hundred this week, the first haze-driven “unhealthy” reading in nearly two years; with below-normal rain forecast into October, plan the outdoor hours around the dashboard, not the calendar.

stories.kicker: Buy It Once · The everyday table
stories.headline: The plate that outlives the pattern
stories.dek: Dinnerware sorts almost entirely by one hidden number — how far the clay vitrified. Learn that, and you can judge any plate in the shop cold, spot the Staffordshire name hiding an Indonesian body, and see why the entry tier already wins.

stories.headline: DeepSeek picks Shanghai, and keeps the crown jewel at home
stories.dek: The lab we flagged as filing to list has now chosen where: it has hired CITIC Securities for a Shanghai STAR Market IPO rather than Hong Kong — a home-team decision that lands two weeks before Xi flies to Washington to talk AI.

stories.kicker: Gear We’re Watching · The headphone that phones home
stories.headline: Sonos builds a headphone that steals the music off your speakers
stories.dek: The Ace Ultra ships this month at US$449 with twice the noise-cancelling and a genuinely new trick — press a button and the audio playing on your Sonos system hands straight to your ears over Wi-Fi. For a reader with the speakers already, that’s the hook; the ecosystem is also the catch.

stories.headline: A jury sits in Venice, and the frontrunner has a fourteen-minute ovation behind him
stories.dek: The Golden Lion is decided tonight under Maggie Gyllenhaal’s jury; Martin McDonagh’s “Wild Horse Nine” is the surest bet on the board — which is exactly why our own sceptic bet against it.

stories.kicker: The Tween Years · The year the rules changed
stories.headline: Age checks arrive just as she reaches the line
stories.dek: Singapore’s new social-media age-assurance regime lands squarely on a twelve-year-old — she is just under the under-thirteen threshold now, and crosses it next July. Here is what the law actually does, and what the evidence behind it does and doesn’t show.

stories.kicker: The Big Picture · The portfolio lens
stories.headline: One barrel, three central banks, no cushion
stories.dek: A chokepoint war put oil near a hundred and ten; the ECB has hiked, the Fed leans the same way, and the ten-year touched five per cent — so stocks and bonds are falling together again, and the diversification you counted on isn’t there.

stories.kicker: The Long Game · The dose that’s enough
stories.headline: Two hours of lifting a week, and the longevity curve flattens
stories.dek: A 2026 analysis of long-term resistance training finds the mortality benefit plateauing around a hundred and twenty minutes a week — the rare fitness headline that gives you permission to stop.

stories.headline: The autumn network wave, and a lounge mid-glow-up
stories.dek: The summer capacity tweaks are unwinding into a fourth-quarter long-haul wave; Scoot points at Okinawa by year-end; and the SilverKris lounge you use is halfway through a rebuild while the RTS Link runs its final tests.

stories.kicker: What’s Worth Booking · The dated agenda
stories.headline: What to book this week — and to plan the flights for
The island that built itself a paycheck
stories.dek: Eighteen million times over, Taiwanese have bought into dividend funds that pay a little every month — the “存股族,” the stock-saving tribe, manufacturing a synthetic salary the wage and the pension no longer provide. In 2026, for the first time, they began quietly walking away from the funds that defined the craze.
